The '''''Lucky Bantha''''' was a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]]. The crew of ''Lucky Bantha'' visited the [[Kattellyn system]], traded with the [[Atrakenite]]s on [[Trilos]], then decided to salvage equipment on [[Atraken/Legends|Atraken]] itself. Unfortunately for the crew, their [[Environment suit/Legends|space suits]] were of a cheap quality, resulting in the crew being exposed to the [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] in Atraken's atmosphere. Upon returning to the ''Lucky Bantha'' and leaving the planet, the crew [[Death/Legends|died]] of radiation poisoning. In addition, the salvage recovered by the crew included a nest of vicious [[diehard]]s who proceeded to wreck the interior of the ship. The ''Lucky Bantha'' was left adrift in the Kattellyn system until discovered by [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] around [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]].
